ok.de: Nach Hardly steht had vor dem Subjekt: Hardly had the update finished when …
ok.en: After Hardly, had stands before the subject: Hardly had the update finished when …

items.text: Hardly the update had finished when the first complaints arrived.

ok.de: Nach Only after steht das Hilfsverb vor dem Subjekt: could we begin.
ok.en: After Only after the auxiliary comes before the subject: could we begin.

items.text: Only after the contract was signed we could begin the migration.

ok.de: Nach Under no circumstances steht should vor dem Subjekt: should you share.
ok.en: After Under no circumstances, should stands before the subject: should you share.

items.text: Under no circumstances you should share your login details with colleagues.

ok.de: Nach Should you steht die Grundform ohne will: Should you have …
ok.en: After Should you the base form follows without will: Should you have …

items.text: Should you will have any questions, please contact the service team.

ok.de: Kein Fehler: Nach Not until am Anfang steht did vor dem Subjekt, wie hier.
ok.en: No mistake: after Not until at the start, did stands before the subject, as here.

items.text: Not until the audit began did the team realize how many files were missing.

ok.de: Kein Fehler: Had we invested ersetzt If we had invested.
ok.en: No mistake: Had we invested replaces If we had invested.

items.text: Had we invested in monitoring earlier, the outage would have been much shorter.

ok.de: Nach Never am Satzanfang steht have vor dem Subjekt: Never have I seen.
ok.en: After Never at the start, have stands before the subject: Never have I seen.

items.text: Never I have seen my grandmother so happy as at the wedding.

ok.de: Nach No sooner steht had vor dem Subjekt: No sooner had we left.
ok.en: After No sooner, had stands before the subject: No sooner had we left.

items.text: No sooner we had left the house than we remembered the keys.

ok.de: Kein Fehler: Nach Only after und dem Nebensatz steht did vor dem Subjekt, wie hier.
ok.en: No mistake: after Only after and the clause, did stands before the subject, as here.

items.text: Only after the movie had ended did the children admit that they were scared.

ok.de: Nach does steht die Grundform: does send.
ok.en: After does the base form follows: does send.

items.text: He does sends the weekly report on time, so please stop worrying.

ok.de: Bei der Voranstellung fehlt as: Hard as we tried, … Ohne as ist der Einwand nicht ausgedrückt.
ok.en: The as is missing in the fronting: Hard as we tried, … Without as the concession is not expressed.

items.text: Hard we tried, we could not reach the client by phone.

ok.de: Der that-Satz nennt die Folge: Such was the demand that …
ok.en: The that-clause names the result: Such was the demand that …

items.text: Such was the demand what the shop ran out of stock within an hour.

ok.de: Nach einem vorgezogenen Objekt bleibt die normale Reihenfolge: we must reverse.
ok.en: After a fronted object the normal order stays: we must reverse.

items.text: This decision must we reverse before the end of the quarter.

ok.de: Kein Fehler: Nach as bleibt die normale Stellung (it is).
ok.en: No mistake: after as the normal order (it is) stays.

items.text: Tempting as it is, we should not skip the final review.

ok.de: Kein Fehler: Nach So great steht das Verb was vor dem Subjekt.
ok.en: No mistake: after So great the verb was stands before the subject.

items.text: So great was the interest that we added a second session on Friday.

ok.de: Bei vorangestelltem Objekt bleibt die Reihenfolge danach normal: This we must always remember.
ok.en: With a fronted object the order after it stays normal: This we must always remember.

items.text: This must we always remember when we plan a family trip.

ok.de: Nach does steht die Grundform: does love.
ok.en: After does the base form follows: does love.

items.text: She does loves her new apartment, even though it is small.

ok.de: Kein Fehler: Adjektiv + as + it may seem räumt etwas ein.
ok.en: No mistake: adjective + as + it may seem concedes a point.

items.text: Strange as it may seem, the best coffee in town is sold at the gas station.

ok.de: Nach hope steht not direkt: I hope not. Hope that not ist im Englischen nicht üblich.
ok.en: After hope, not follows directly: I hope not. Hope that not is not used in English.

items.text: Will the update be ready by Monday? I hope that not, because the testers are away.

ok.de: Kein Fehler: Did the same ersetzt changed our logo.
ok.en: No mistake: Did the same replaces changed our logo.

items.text: Our rivals changed their logo, and we did the same last month.

ok.de: Hinter dem Adjektiv cheaper braucht es one.
ok.en: After the adjective cheaper you need one.

items.text: Our current provider is expensive, so we are looking for a cheaper.

ok.de: Am Ende muss to stehen bleiben: I would like to.
ok.en: At the end to has to stay: I would like to.

items.text: Can you attend the workshop on Friday? Yes, I would like.

ok.de: Gebühren werden mit Gebühren verglichen: those of the new provider.
ok.en: Fees are compared with fees: those of the new provider.

fix: than those of the new provider
choices: than those of the new provider
than that of the new provider
than the ones the new provider

items.text: The fees of our provider are higher than the new provider.

ok.de: Kein Fehler: One ersetzt das Nomen tool.
ok.en: No mistake: One replaces the noun tool.

items.text: The new tool is faster than the old one, but the old one is cheaper to run.

ok.de: Vor same steht the: do the same.
ok.en: Before same you need the: do the same.

items.text: My sister cleaned the kitchen yesterday, and I will do same tomorrow.

ok.de: Nach be afraid steht not für den verneinten Gedanken: I am afraid not.
ok.en: After be afraid, not stands for the negative thought: I am afraid not.

items.text: Is the café open today? I am afraid no, it closes on Mondays.

ok.de: Kein Fehler: Das Verb join entfällt, aber to bleibt: told me not to.
ok.en: No mistake: the verb join is dropped, but to stays: told me not to.

items.text: I wanted to join the choir, but my friends told me not to.

ok.de: Es heißt I hope not, nicht I do not hope so. Not ersetzt den Gedanken.
ok.en: It is I hope not, not I do not hope so. Not replaces the thought.

items.text: Will it rain on the weekend? I do not hope so, because we are planning a picnic.

ok.de: Nach neither steht das Hilfsverb vor dem Subjekt: neither do I.
ok.en: After neither the auxiliary comes before the subject: neither do I.

items.text: I do not like coffee, and neither I do, so we ordered water.

ok.de: Hinter dem Adjektiv new braucht es one.
ok.en: After the adjective new you need one.

items.text: My phone is old, so I bought a new on the weekend.

ok.de: Nach dem Nomen offer steht that, which oder nichts, nie what.
ok.en: After the noun offer comes that, which or nothing, never what.

items.text: Is this the only offer what we have received so far?

ok.de: Die Dokumente werden erstellt: Passiv braucht die 3. Form prepared.
ok.en: The documents are prepared: the passive needs the past participle prepared.

items.text: The documents prepare by the finance team are stored on the shared drive.

ok.de: Der Besitz steht mit ’s: the manager’s decision.
ok.en: Possession takes ’s: the manager’s decision.

items.text: The manager decision surprised the whole team on Monday.

ok.de: Nach way steht to + Grundform: to increase.
ok.en: After way comes to + base form: to increase.

items.text: This is the best way for increase our sales in Asia.

ok.de: Kein Fehler: Working ersetzt who is working.
ok.en: No mistake: Working replaces who is working.

items.text: Everyone working on the migration received the new access rules.

ok.de: Kein Fehler: Nach the last speaker folgt to + Grundform.
ok.en: No mistake: after the last speaker comes to + base form.

items.text: He was the last speaker to present at the conference on Thursday.

ok.de: Das Partizip mit Ergänzung steht hinter dem Nomen: a package tailored to small teams.
ok.en: The participle with its phrase stands after the noun: a package tailored to small teams.

choices: package that tailored to small teams

items.text: We sell a tailored to small teams package this season.

ok.de: Die Kinder werden einbezogen, deshalb das passive Partizip: the children involved.
ok.en: The children are involved, so the passive participle is used: the children involved.

items.text: The children involving in the school play need to arrive by eight.

ok.de: Nach the best way steht to + Grundform: the best way to save.
ok.en: After the best way comes to + base form: the best way to save.

items.text: The best way for save money is to cook at home.

ok.de: Kein Fehler: Zeitangaben nehmen ’s, und last week’s ersetzt das Nomen.
ok.en: No mistake: time words take ’s, and last week’s replaces the noun.

items.text: Yesterday’s lesson was much shorter than last week’s.
